summary: No mathematical errors or gaps were found. The slice census, all-center reflection ledger, and old- and new-center conditions are exact. The vertex containment and vertex bound hold without assuming P=conv(D). Both uses of the accepted vertex-deficit inequality satisfy its finiteness, lattice-convexity, reflection-count, and ambient-dimension hypotheses with the stated normalization. The necessary inequalities and the all-apex obstruction for the accepted twenty-point tetrahedron follow correctly, including the conclusion that every lift has maximum reflection count at least five.
